meta.name: rescue
meta.description: Triage an outage, loss of stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction. Use for urgent recovery; distinguish diagnosis from authorized production mitigation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 稳住线上事故或濒临失控的合作局面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果线上出了故障或项目快谈崩,需要快速判断先做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Stabilize an outage or a failing engagement before it gets worse
copy.fit_line_en: For you if an outage or a strained client relationship needs fast triage.

howto.what: 它按任务上下文契约和 rescue 方法，对线上故障、信任受损或项目方向失败做分诊，并把诊断与经授权的生产缓解区分开。需要时再加载更多参考文件。
howto.when: 当你遇到线上故障、利益相关方信任受损或项目方向失败，需要紧急恢复时触发；会从已有上下文直接开工，不重启已答过的设置或提问。

say.text: 线上服务挂了，帮我做故障分诊，先诊断，别动生产
say.note: 按 rescue 方法分诊，区分诊断与缓解

say.text: 客户已经不信我们了，这次事故怎么紧急挽回
say.note: 走信任受损的恢复流程

say.text: 这个项目方向可能走错了，帮我判断要不要调整

howto.what_en: It triages outages, lost stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction using the task-context contract and rescue method, separating diagnosis from authorized production mitigation, loading more references only when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you face an outage, loss of stakeholder trust or a failing engagement direction and need urgent recovery; it works from existing context without restarting setup or questions already answered.

say_en.text: The service is down; help me triage it and diagnose first, without touching prod
say_en.note: Triages per the rescue method, separating diagnosis from mitigation

say_en.text: The client no longer trusts us; how do we recover urgently
This project direction may be wrong; help me judge whether to change it
